text:
maya: Quick heads-up — final preflight for the 0.14.0 wave. Targeting cutover 10:00 PDT tomorrow. Need version bumps & changelogs across api, runtime, console, sdk by EOD today. Ping if blocked.

jon: Got it. I'll lock the release window in calendar. What do we need from runtime?

tina: For runtime: I need the API's minor change (auth header) merged — that PR hasn't been rebased. If it's in by 17:00 PDT I can cut the runtime tag and start canary.

sam: Console: small UI tweaks landed. Will update package.json to 0.14.0 and add changelog entry. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/456

rachel: SDK: breaking change? No — only header rename — will do patch bump 0.13.5 -> 0.14.0 to align. I'll open PR for version + changelog now.

maya: two small asks: 1) add the changelog snippet under "Unreleased" with a one-liner and PR link; 2) leave a "ready-for-release" label on PR. Also, put target commit SHAs in this thread.

jon: re: labels — I'll add a repo rule to auto-apply "ready-for-release" for PRs that pass CI and include "changelog".

release-bot: Canary window reserved 10:00-11:00 PDT. Fallback policies set to prev-stable if canary fails.

tina: runtime PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789 — needs a quick rebase. Mina from infra has context on the perf test — @mina can you sign off after rebase?

infra-bot: perf-check triggered for runtime/pr/789 on commit abc123. Results: lat p50 +3% vs baseline. Tag "needs-investigation" added.

mina: I'll look in 20m. If it's perf noise we'll ignore. @tina can you post the perf-compare link?

tina: https://perf.redwood.com/compare?left=baseline&right=abc123 — looks borderline. I'll rerun with different seed.

rachel: SDK PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/312 — version + changelog added. CI green.

sam: console PR merged. Version bumped on main: console@0.14.0 — SHA deadbeef.

maya: Great. Can everyone paste the commit SHA they're planning to release (api, runtime, console, sdk)? I'll assemble the release manifest.

jon: API SHA: cafebab1 (PR #1023)

tina: runtime SHA (will cut tag from this commit after green): abc123

sam: console SHA: deadbeef

rachel: sdk SHA: 0ff1ce

maya: Changelog nudge: please use the "Release notes" template in docs/release-notes.md — we want single-sentence bullets. Also any customer-facing language must go through @support for wording.

support-bot: Heads-up: No customer-impacting changes flagged in these PRs. If language touches billing/SLAs, ping us.

jon: Cutoff reminder: Last call for any post-cutoff hotfixes is 09:00 PDT tomorrow. After that only critical fixes via hotfix branch and approval from eng leads.

tina: We'll aim to have runtime tag cut by 18:30 today to allow perf baseline runs.

maya: Action items checklist (maya): 1) collect SHAs → I got four; 2) update release manifest in /releases/0.14.0/manifest.yaml; 3) confirm canary rollout schedule with infra; 4) post final release notes to #announcements.

tina: +1 on cut time. @jon can you coordinate the release copy once I confirm canary?

jon: Yep.

sam: Small gotcha: console uses semver for CDN assets. Need to trigger CDN invalidation after release. Sam will handle and post CDN purge ticket number.

sam: CDN purge ticket #2456

rachel: SDK: I'll publish npm dist-tag "next" after canary looks good, then "latest" after GA.

maya: Cool. If anyone gets blocked, drop the "release-hot" emoji or DM me directly. Thanks all :rocket:

maya: Example changelog snippet to copy into each repo's Unreleased section:
```
- Fix: normalize auth header for SDK and API (PR #1023)
```

release-bot: Release manifest updated at /releases/0.14.0/manifest.yaml by maya — manifest contains: {"api": "cafebab1", "runtime": "abc123", "console": "deadbeef", "sdk": "0ff1ce"}.

maya: I'll post final notes to #announcements once we have green canary. Leaving this open for any late blockers.

jon: Thanks — will monitor the channel during cutover.

mina: Quick note: if perf rerun still shows +3% we should consider increasing canary traffic to 5% for one hour rather than blocking.

tina: Agree. I'll push a rerun now.

maya: Closing loop later today. :white_check_mark:
